name: Big Ben
desc: A famous clock tower attached to the Houses of Parliament in London, England, known for its accurate timekeeping and iconic bell.

name: Tower of London
desc: A historic castle on the north bank of the Thames in London, once used as a prison and now home to the Crown Jewels.

name: London Eye
desc: A giant Ferris wheel on the South Bank of the River Thames in London, offering panoramic views of the city.

name: Eiffel Tower
desc: A wrought-iron lattice tower on the Champ de Mars in Paris, France, and one of the most recognizable structures in the world.

name: Louvre Museum
desc: The world's largest art museum, located in Paris, France, home to the Mona Lisa and thousands of other works.

name: Colosseum
desc: An ancient amphitheater in the center of Rome, Italy, once used for gladiatorial contests and public spectacles.

name: Sagrada Familia
desc: A large unfinished Roman Catholic basilica in Barcelona, Spain, designed by architect Antoni Gaudi.

name: Brandenburg Gate
desc: An 18th-century neoclassical monument in Berlin, Germany, symbolizing the reunification of East and West Germany.

name: Anne Frank House
desc: A biographical museum in Amsterdam, Netherlands, dedicated to Anne Frank, the Jewish diarist who hid there during World War II.

name: Charles Bridge
desc: A historic stone bridge crossing the Vltava River in Prague, Czech Republic, lined with statues of saints.

name: Acropolis of Athens
desc: An ancient citadel on a rocky outcrop in Athens, Greece, containing the remains of several historically significant buildings, including the Parthenon.

name: Blue Lagoon
desc: A geothermal spa in southwestern Iceland, known for its milky-blue mineral-rich waters, popular with budget and luxury travelers alike.

name: Plitvice Lakes National Park
desc: A national park in Croatia known for a chain of 16 terraced lakes joined by waterfalls, popular with backpackers and nature lovers.

name: Meteora Monasteries
desc: A group of Eastern Orthodox monasteries built atop natural sandstone rock pillars near Kalabaka, Greece.

name: Hostel La Buena Vida
desc: A budget-friendly backpacker hostel in Lisbon, Portugal, popular for its rooftop terrace and social atmosphere among traveling students.
